chunk: apps/Q-Mintership+/legacy/assets/js/Q-Mintership.js lines 1-1933 (whole file): app entry point, hash routing, nav gating, forum rooms
summary: Q-Mintership.js is the last script loaded by index.html and is the app's entry point. On DOMContentLoaded it wires the six nav targets (MINTERSHIP-FORUM, MINTERS/MINTER-BOARD, ADDREMOVEADMIN, STATS, and admin-only ADMINBOARD and TOOLS), verifies admin status through verifyUserIsAdmin (group membership of 721/1/673 by name plus admin of minter group 694), removes the two admin links from the DOM for non-admins, registers a hashchange router and resolves any initial hash. The router accepts #/board/card/section and ?board=&card=&section= forms with board aliases, lazily loads the board script, waits up to 90 s for the DOM element card-shell-<cardIdentifier>, expands minter list-mode details (section all|comments|full), highlights and scrolls to it. The rest of the file is the forum: three rooms (minters, general and admin-only admins) whose messages are BLOG_POST resources named mintership-forum-message-<room>-<6charId> (admins: MAIL_PRIVATE, mintership-forum-message-admins-e-<6charId>, encrypted for all admin public keys), each a base64 JSON {messageHtml, hasAttachment, attachments[], replyTo} with attachments published as FILE / FILE_PRIVATE mintership-forum-attachment-<room>[-e]-<6charId>-<index> in the same PUBLISH_MULTIPLE_QDN_RESOURCES call. Messages are paged 10 at a time oldest-first via /arbitrary/resources/searchsimple, fetched with FETCH_QDN_RESOURCE (plus DECRYPT_DATA for admins), cached in an in-memory map of 2000, and a 40 s setInterval re-polls the current page. Every page load and poll tick also runs a fetch-all count loop for pagination, and opening a room with a remembered last message runs a limit=0 search.

identifiers.jsonShape: base64 of JSON { messageHtml: string (Quill HTML), hasAttachment: boolean, attachments: Array<{ name: string, service: "FILE", identifier: string, filename: string, mimeType: string }>, replyTo: string | null }
identifiers.notes: Search prefixes used exactly: 'mintership-forum-message-minters', 'mintership-forum-message-general' (prefix=true). Read shape after fetch: FETCH_QDN_RESOURCE returns the parsed JSON object directly (no encoding param). Timestamp = resource.updated || resource.created. In-memory Message = { name, content (messageHtml or 'Message content missing'), date ('YYYY-MM-DD @ HH:MM:SS'), identifier, replyTo, timestamp, attachments }.

bugs.description: Empty room crashes the loader: searchSimple returns null (not []) when there are no results, so `response.length` at 1265 throws TypeError; it is swallowed by the outer try/catch, so the 'No messages found. Be the first to post!' empty state (1353) is never shown and pagination is not rendered. findMessagePage (1232) has the same null.findIndex problem.

Unbounded QDN reads on every forum interaction: findMessagePage searches the whole room with limit=0 each time a room with a remembered last message is opened, and updatePaginationControls -> searchAllCountOnly walks the entire room in 100-item pages (until an empty page) after every page load AND every 40 s poll tick, only to count messages.
Resume-at-last-message never scrolls: latestId is already the identifier string, but scrollToMessage is called with latestId.latestIdentifier (undefined).

False success: publishMultipleResources catches errors and returns null (user cancelled, no keys, Hub error), yet handleSendMessage always clears the composer and shows 'Successfully Published!'. The typed message and attachments are lost.

Polling leaks: startPollingForNewMessages uses setInterval that is never cleared; every click on FORUM adds another 40 s poller; pollers keep firing on other boards (no-op only because .room-title is gone) and never pause when the tab is hidden.
Polling only refetches the current page in oldest-first order, so a brand-new message that lands on a new (later) page is never shown or flagged NEW; only the pagination count grows.

Reply preview goes stale: if a reply preview already exists and the user clicks Reply on a different message, replyToMessageIdentifier is updated but the visible 'Replying to:' block still shows the first message; the published replyTo does not match what the user sees.

Encrypted publish with an empty key list: handleSendMessage only checks userState.isAdmin; if savedAdminData fetch failed adminPublicKeys is [] (truthy), so PUBLISH_MULTIPLE_QDN_RESOURCES is sent with encrypt:true, publicKeys:[] and the message is unreadable by everyone (or rejected).

Stale admin key set: the forum admin room encrypts to savedAdminData.publicKeys from localStorage with no TTL; this file only fetches when the cache is missing, and the cache is refreshed only when the Admin Board page loads (AdminBoard.js:298). New admins cannot read messages published by users with an old cache; removed admins still can.

A single failing reply lookup aborts rendering of the whole page: buildReplyHtml rethrows (1667-1669) inside buildMessageHTML, which is awaited inside the renderNewMessages loop, so the remaining messages on the page are never inserted (error swallowed at 1305).

DOMContentLoaded aborts on any admin-check error: `await verifyUserIsAdmin()` rethrows (QortalApi.js:458-461), so with no Core access / no account the handler stops before removing admin links, registering hashchange, and resolving the initial deep link.

Quill is re-instantiated on the same #editor container on every Publish click and in clearInputs (Quill 1.3.6). The toolbar module stays bound to the first instance whose root is discarded, so after the first publish the toolbar buttons no longer act on the visible editor; the author's own TODO admits this is not understood.

Deep link #/admin (and aliases) loads the Admin Board for non-admins: focusBoardRoute has no admin check and loadAdminBoardPage (AdminBoard.js:85) has none either; admin gating is nav-only. Data is encrypted, so no leak, but the page opens and fails noisily.

Empty message can be published: Quill's empty document is '


', which is truthy, so `if (messageHtml || ...)` lets a blank message through.

Image preview Remove uses the index captured at render time; after one removal the later indices are stale, so the wrong file is spliced out of selectedImages (the thumbnail removed is right, the published set is wrong).

Event listeners accumulate: setupModalHandlers adds a document click listener every time a room is opened; handleReplyLogic re-adds click listeners to every existing Reply button on every load and poll tick.
Image modal 'Download' button (#download-button) has no click handler.

'Add Images to Multi-Publish' is rendered display:none and disabled, so the multi-publish path (1015-1020) is unreachable; the unused attachmentID at line 980 and the localStorage persistence helpers (36-61) are also dead code.
verifyUserIsAdmin (2 Core calls, one with limit=0) is repeated on every loadForumPage for non-admin users because only a true result is memoised.
Header avatar URL does not URI-encode the account name (message avatars do).
Admins-room images are fetched and decrypted eagerly (one fetch + one DECRYPT_DATA per image) during render, before anything is shown; public-room images and avatars are plain without loading=lazy.

uxProblems.description: No loading state: the message container is emptied and stays blank until all fetches and decrypts finish; no error state either (errors go to console only).
Oldest-first paging puts the newest messages on the last page; users must click to the end each time (the 'resume' feature that should help is broken).
One numbered button per page with no cap: a busy room with 500 messages renders 50 buttons.
Publish has no in-progress/disabled state; double clicks can publish twice, and there is no optimistic insert (users are told to wait for confirmation).
window.alert for the unauthorised admin-room case and console-only warnings elsewhere.
Two separate file pickers ('Select Files' vs 'Select IMAGES w/Preview') plus a hidden third button is confusing; non-image previews do not exist.
Reply preview shows the full HTML of the quoted message with no truncation; quoted blocks in the list likewise show the entire replied-to message.
Deep-link failure is silent: after 90 s of polling the DOM nothing tells the user the card was not found.
Admin links are removed without explanation and the remaining home card is re-centred by class juggling; the home page layout is hard-coded Bootstrap/Mobirise.
All chrome is inline-styled with hard-coded colours (lightblue, white, black, red, green, #ccc) and vw-sized controls; nothing follows a theme.
NEW badges and scroll-to-new only apply to the page being viewed; there is no unread count per room.
Room switch resets to page 0 and re-runs the full count loop; no cache of pages already seen in the session.
